explanation: High at GO (7-9; 9 after an unrewarded trial, 7-8 after a rewarded one) and at D2, where D2 is 10 when a1 led rarely to S2, 8-9 after a common transition (7 if that trial D1 was 0), and 5-6 when a2 led rarely to S1. Low at D1: 0 if the previous trial was rewarded in S2, 2 if it was rewarded in S1, and usually 4-6 (sometimes 2) if the previous trial was unrewarded.
